title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Zay Flowers (hamstring) takes part in individual drills Friday
items.desc: Zay Flowers took part in some of the individual drills in practice on Friday.
items.impact: Flowers remains unlikely to play on Sunday after missing practice the past two days. His status will still need to be monitored on the official injury report.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Colby Parkinson (knee) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Colby Parkinson will be listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Broncos.
items.impact: Parkinson will go through a jog-through on Friday. Rams head coach Sean McVay said he is "trending in the right direction" to play.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ed Oliver (hip) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Ed Oliver is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Chargers.
items.impact: Oliver closed the week with a full practice on Friday. He should be good to go on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Oronde Gadsden II 'ready to step up' per HC Jim Harbaugh
items.desc: Chargers head coach Jim Harbaugh said TE Oronde Gadsden II is "ready to step up."
items.impact: Gadsden will be stepping into a bigger role with both David Njoku and Charlie Kolar sidelined. He'll be a viable streamer for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Brenen Thompson (quad) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Brenen Thompson has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Bills.
items.impact: Thompson remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Josh Simmons (back) does not practice Friday
items.desc: Josh Simmons remained absent from practice on Friday.
items.impact: Simmons remains without a clear timetable to return for the Chiefs.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chamarri Conner (knee) will not play Sunday
items.desc: Chamarri Conner will not play in Sunday's game against the Dolphins.
items.impact: Conner has been able to return to practice this week. He could be back for the Chiefs next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Mansoor Delane (shoulder) has 'good chance' to play Sunday
items.desc: Chiefs head coach Andy Reid said there's a "good chance" Mansoor Delane plays on Sunday against the Dolphins.
items.impact: Delane opened the week with a full practice. The rookie should be good to go on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Puka Nacua (hip) listed doubtful Sunday, expected to return Week 4
items.desc: Puka Nacua is listed as doubtful for Sunday's game against the Broncos.
items.impact: Nacua is likely to miss a second straight game. Rams head coach Sean McVay said the expectation is he'll be good to go for Week 4.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring) good to go for Sunday
items.desc: Travis Etienne Jr. has been cleared for Sunday's game against the Raiders.
items.impact: Etienne has been dealing with a hamstring injury this week. He'll be a risky RB2 play for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kendre Miller (illness) returns to practice Friday
items.desc: Kendre Miller was back at practice on Friday.
items.impact: Miller had been absent due to an illness. He'll need to be monitored when the injury report is released.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Keon Coleman (ankle) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Keon Coleman is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Chargers.
items.impact: Coleman was unable to practice on Thursday. His status will need to be monitored closer to kickoff on Sunday. DJ Moore (shoulder) is also listed as questionable.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: DJ Moore (shoulder) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: DJ Moore is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Chargers.
items.impact: Moore returned to practice in a non-contact jersey on Friday. His status will need to be monitored closer to kickoff on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jonathan Allen (knee) will play Sunday
items.desc: Bengals head coach Zac Taylor said Jonathan Allen will play in Week 3 against the Steelers.
items.impact: Taylor returned to practice on Friday following back-to-back absences.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Xavier Legette (knee) to likely be game-time decision Sunday
items.desc: Xavier Legette is expected to be a game-time decision for Sunday's game against the Browns.
items.impact: Legette was able to return to practice on Friday. He remains off the fantasy radar if he is cleared.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jalen Coker (ankle) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Jalen Coker has been listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Browns.
items.impact: Coker returned to practice on Friday. He appears to be trending in the right direction. He'll remain an upside WR3 play for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Aidan O'Connell (personal) not at practice Friday
items.desc: Aidan O'Connell remained absent from practice on Friday.
items.impact: O'Connell remains uncertain heading into Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Treydan Stukes (concussion) not at practice Friday
items.desc: Treydan Stukes was not at practice on Friday.
items.impact: Stukes was placed in concussion protocol to begin the week. He will likely miss at least one game.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Brock Bowers (knee) not seen at practice Friday
items.desc: Brock Bowers was not seen at practice on Friday.
items.impact: This is worth noting after Bowers was limited in practice earlier this week. His name will be one to monitor when the official injury report is released.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Josiah Trotter (shoulder) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Josiah Trotter has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Vikings.
items.impact: Trotter was unable to practice this week. He will be sidelined for at least one game.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rueben Bain Jr. (groin) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Rueben Bain Jr. has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Vikings.
items.impact: Bain was unable to practice all week. It has been a slow start through two games for the rookie.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ashton Dulin (ankle) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Ashton Dulin has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Texans.
items.impact: Laquon Treadwell will see some more run in the Colts wide receiver room.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Craig Woodson (shoulder) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Craig Woodson is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Jaguars.
items.impact: Woodson had missed practice on Thursday. His status will need to be monitored closer to kickoff on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Quintayvious Hutchins (knee) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Quintayvious Hutchins has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Jaguars.
items.impact: The Patriots depth in their linebacker room will be short-handed.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dre'Mont Jones (shoulder) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Dre'Mont Jones has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Jaguars.
items.impact: Jones was unable to practice for due to a shoulder injury. The Patriots defensive line will be short-handed on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Eli Raridon (thigh) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Eli Raridon is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Jaguars.
items.impact: Raridon is on the injury report with a thigh issue. He remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Teven Jenkins (back) ruled out Sunday
items.desc: Teven Jenkins has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Panthers.
items.impact: Jenkins remained sidelined from practice all week. He'll miss another game with a back injury.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Grant Delpit (shoulder) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Grant Delpit is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Panthers.
items.impact: Delpit was limited in practice on Wednesday and Thursday to begin the week. He should be on the favorable side of questionable heading into Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyson Campbell (ankle/hip) listed questionable Sunday
items.desc: Tyson Campbell is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Panthers.
items.impact: Campbell has been banged up this week with multiple injuries. His status will need to be monitored closer to kickoff.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Quinshon Judkins (personal) off injury report Sunday
items.desc: Quinshon Judkins is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Panthers.
items.impact: Judkins landed on the injury report for personal reasons this week. He'll remain an RB2 off volume this week for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Aaron Jones Sr. (knee) practices Friday
items.desc: Aaron Jones Sr. practiced again on Friday.
items.impact: Jones was limited in his return to practice on Thursday. He should be in line for another lead role on Sunday against the Buccaneers. He'll be an RB2 play for fantasy managers.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Tyjae Spears (ankle) practicing Friday
items.desc: Tyjae Spears (ankle) is returning to practice for the Tennessee Titans Friday according to Turron Davenport.
items.impact: Spears is back after being unable to practice Thursday, rejoining fellow backfield mate Tony Pollard (ankle) on the practice field for head coach Robert Saleh in preparation for a Week 3 matchup against the New York Giants.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Tony Pollard (ankle) practicing fully Friday
items.desc: Tony Pollard (ankle) will log a full practice session for the Tennessee Titans Friday according to Turron Davenport.
items.impact: Pollard has increased his practice participation throughout the week, boding well for his chances of suiting up for head coach Robert Saleh against the New York Giants Sunday.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Nick Bosa (calf) may avoid injured reserve
items.desc: Nick Bosa (calf) may avoid injured reserve as the San Francisco 49ers are leaning towards not placing him on it due to lack of available spots according to Adam Schefter.
items.impact: Bosa suffered the calf injury during Thursday's practice session, but with the organization suffering from a plethora of injuries already, the pass rusher's status moving forward from a roster standpoint remains uncertain.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Devin Lloyd (calf) misses another practice Friday
items.desc: Devin Lloyd (calf) did not take part in Friday's practice session.
items.impact: Lloyd has been missing from practice all week long, leaving his status very much in doubt for Week 3. Jackson Kuwatch would likely see increased snaps if Lloyd sits.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Caleb Douglas (ankle) will not play Sunday
items.desc: Caleb Douglas (ankle) will miss Week 3's matchup against the Chiefs.
items.impact: Douglas has been missing at practice this week due to an ankle injury. The third-round rookie is currently the Dolphins' leading receiver through two games, but he will not be in action this week. Look for fellow rookies Chris Bell and Kevin Coleman Jr. to see increased playing time in Douglas' absence.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Mason Taylor (thumb) out for Week 3
items.desc: Mason Taylor (thumb) will not play Sunday in Detroit.
items.impact: Taylor is dealing with a thumb injury that has kept him from practicing this week. He will not play Sunday, leaving more snaps for first-round rookie Kenyon Sadiq, as well as Jeremy Ruckert and Jelani Woods.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Adonai Mitchell (finger) remains limited Friday
items.desc: Adonai Mitchell (finger) remained a limited participant at Friday's practice session.
items.impact: Mitchell caught his finger in a jersey at Thursday's practice. He is at least getting some work in, but this is a situation to monitor ahead of Sunday. Mitchell has hauled in nine passes for 123 yards over this first two games of the season.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Chig Okonkwo (hamstring) unlikely for Week 3
items.desc: Chig Okonkwo (hamstring) is unlikely to play in Week 3's matchup against the Seahawks.
items.impact: A hamstring injury held Okonkwo out of this past Sunday's loss to the Cowboys. It's likely to do so again this upcoming Sunday. Ben Sinnott should be the beneficiary of more playing time once again.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Jalen Carter (wrist) limited at Thursday's practice
items.desc: Jalen Carter (wrist) got in a limited practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: Carter played 41 snaps (77%) this past Sunday. The fourth-year defensive tackle is still questionable, but he has been getting in limited activity at practice this week. He should play Monday.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Jonathan Greenard (pectoral) limited Thursday
items.desc: Jonathan Greenard (pectoral) was limited during Thursday's practice session.
items.impact: Greenard has not played yet this season, but he seems to have a chance to take the field Monday night. The veteran edge rusher totaled 38 tackles and 3.0 sacks over 12 games for the Vikings last season. He racked up a combined 24.5 sacks between 2023 and 2024.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) did not practice Thursday
items.desc: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) did not take part in Thursday's practice session.
items.impact: Smith delivered a huge game for the Eagles in this past Sunday's win over the Titans, but he has reportedly been dealing with a hamstring issue at practice this week. Smith did not practice Thursday, but he still seems likely to play Monday. This is a situation to be aware of, however.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Jayden Daniels (elbow) not going on IR
items.desc: Jarden Daniels (elbow) will not be placed on IR.
items.impact: Daniels has undergone multiple tests this week, and the Washington QB will avoid going on injured reserve. Instead, Daniels has been listed week-to-week with aim of getting back on the field as soon as possible. Backup quarterback Marcus Mariota is still expected to start in Week 3, but Daniels might be in play for Week 4.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Green Bay Packers D/ST run over by Atlanta in loss
items.desc: The Green Bay Packers D/ST managed an early interception before going quiet on the box score for the rest of the game in the Packers' 35-14 loss to the Falcons.
items.impact: The Packers pulled off a pick four plays into the game, but didn't put anything else on the stat sheet afterwards. It was a dominant outing by the Falcons offense, with the Packers defense unable to stop Drake London or the ground game led by Bijan and Brian Robinson, who collectively averaged 5.9 yards per carry on the night. They'll look to be better next time out.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Trey Smack quiet in loss to Falcons
items.desc: Trey Smack hit both of his PATs in the Packers' 35-14 loss to the Falcons.
items.impact: Smack hit both of his chances, but the Packers either couldn't get into field goal range, or decided to go for it on fourth down when they did. Better days will come for the kicker, and the Green Bay offense can still put up points on any given week. Their run game is stifling them at the moment, so if they figure that out, the points will come.
